title: DaVinci IQ3 Flavor Chamber
description:
Zirconia flavor chamber replacement part for DaVinci IQ3 Vaporizer.

The flavor chamber is made of zirconia ceramic; an extremely durable material that will give the purest vapor quality and keep the flavor intact.

*Does not include Cool Core™
